"""
Browser Session REST API Router

Handles CRUD operations for browser sessions with full async support.
Endpoints:
    GET    /api/browsers              - List all sessions
    POST   /api/browsers              - Create new session
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id> - Get session details
    DELETE /api/browsers/<session_id> - Stop & delete session
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/action    - Execute browser action
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/screenshot - Take screenshot
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/source     - Get page source
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/restart    - Restart session
"""

import logging
from typing import List
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Depends, Request, status

from codx.junior.engine.session import CODXJuniorSession
from codx.junior.api.browser_models import (
    BrowserSessionResponse,
    BrowserSessionListResponse,
    BrowserSessionCreateRequest,
    BrowserSessionActionRequest,
    BrowserActionResponse,
    BrowserScreenshotResponse,
    BrowserSourceResponse,
)
from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/browsers", tags=["browser"])


# ============================================================================
# Dependencies
# ============================================================================

async def get_session_context(request: Request) -> CODXJuniorSession:
    """Dependency: get current session context from request state."""
    session = getattr(request.state, 'codx_junior_session', None)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="No active session"
        )
    return session


# ============================================================================
# Endpoints
# ============================================================================

@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionListResponse,
    summary="List all browser sessions",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "List of browser sessions"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def list_sessions(request: Request):
    """
    List all browser sessions for the current project.

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionListResponse with count and list of sessions
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        sessions = browser_manager.list_sessions()
        responses = [
            BrowserSessionResponse(**s.to_dict())
            for s in sessions
        ]
        logger.info("list_sessions: returned %d browser sessions", len(sessions))
        return BrowserSessionListResponse(count=len(responses), sessions=responses)
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("list_sessions: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Create a new browser session",
    responses={
        201: {"description": "Session created"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid request"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def create_session(
    request: Request,
    req: BrowserSessionCreateRequest,
):
    """
    Create and start a new browser session.

    Starts a Firefox Docker container with Traefik routing and persistent profile.

    Args:
        req: BrowserSessionCreateRequest with chat_id

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionResponse with session details or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        # Validate chat exists
        chat_manager = ChatManager(session.settings)
        chat = chat_manager.get_chat(req.chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("create_session: chat not found: %s", req.chat_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Chat not found")

        # Create browser session
        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(req.chat_id)

        # Sync to chat metadata
        browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
        chat_manager.save_chat(chat)

        logger.info(
            "create_session: created browser session %s for chat %s",
            browser_session.id[:8],
            req.chat_id
        )

        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("create_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get(
    "/{session_id}",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    summary="Get session details",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Session details"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def get_session(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
):
    """
    Get details for a specific browser session.

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionResponse with session details or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("get_session: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        logger.info("get_session: retrieved session %s", session_id[:8])
        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("get_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.delete(
    "/{session_id}",
    status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT,
    summary="Stop and delete a session",
    responses={
        204: {"description": "Session deleted"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def delete_session(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
):
    """
    Stop Docker container and delete a browser session.

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID to delete

    Returns:
        Empty response on success, error dict on failure
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None

        try:

                title = await browser.navigate(req.url)

                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for click action")
                await browser.click(req.selector)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: click action completed for session %s on %s",

                    success=True,
                    message=f"Clicked {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector}
                )

            elif req.action == "fill":
                if not req.selector or not req.value:
                    logger.error("execute_action: fill action missing selector or value")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and value required for fill action")
                await browser.fill(req.selector, req.value)

                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: fill action completed for session %s on %s",

                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Filled {req.selector}",

                if not req.script:
                    logger.error("execute_action: execute action missing script")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Script required for execute action")
                result = await browser.execute_script(req.script)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: execute action completed for session %s",
                    session_id[:8]
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message="Script executed",
                    data={"result": result}
                )

            else:
                logger.error("execute_action: unknown action: %s", req.action)
                raise HTTPException(400, f"Unknown action: {req.action}")

        finally:
            await browser.close()

    except HTTPException:

    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("execute_action: unexpected error: %s", e)

"""
Browser Session REST API Router

Handles CRUD operations for browser sessions with full async support.
Endpoints:
    GET    /api/browsers              - List all sessions
    POST   /api/browsers              - Create new session
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id> - Get session details
    DELETE /api/browsers/<session_id> - Stop & delete session
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/action    - Execute browser action
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/screenshot - Take screenshot
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/source     - Get page source
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/restart    - Restart session

async def get_session_context(request: Request) -> CODXJuniorSession:
    """Dependency: get current session context from request state."""
    session = getattr(request.state, 'codx_junior_session', None)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="No active session"

from typing import List, Optional

        default=False,

    )

@sio.on("codx-junior-browser-create")
@sio_api_endpoint
async def sio_browser_create(sid, data: dict, codxjunior_session: CODXJuniorSession):
    """
    Create a new browser session via Socket.IO.
    Sends real-time status updates as the session starts.
    
    Request data:
        - chat_id: str - Associated chat ID
    
    Emits events:
        - codx-junior-browser-status: {status, session_id, message, error}
    """
    channel = SessionChannel(sio=sio, sid=sid)
    chat_id = data.get("chat_id")
    
    if not chat_id:
        logger.error("sio_browser_create: chat_id is required")
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "chat_id is required",
            "error": "Missing chat_id"
        })
        return
    
    try:
        from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
        from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager
        
        # Validate chat exists
        chat_manager = ChatManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("sio_browser_create: chat not found: %s", chat_id)
            channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
                "status": "error",
                "message": "Chat not found",
                "error": f"Chat {chat_id} not found"
            })
            return
        
        # Emit starting event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "starting",
            "message": "Creating browser session...",
            "chat_id": chat_id
        })
        
        # Create browser session
        browser_manager = BrowserManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(chat_id)
        
        # Emit creation event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "created",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": f"Browser session {browser_session.id[:8]} created",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict()
        })
        
        # Emit starting container event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "starting_container",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": "Starting Docker container...",
            "container_id": browser_session.container_id
        })
        
        # Sync to chat metadata
        browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
        chat_manager.save_chat(chat)
        
        # Emit ready event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "ready",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": f"Browser session ready",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict()
        })
        
        logger.info(
            "sio_browser_create: created session %s for chat %s",
            browser_session.id[:8],
            chat_id
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("sio_browser_create: unexpected error: %s", e)
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "Failed to create browser session",
            "error": str(e)
        })


@sio.on("codx-junior-browser-delete")
@sio_api_endpoint
async def sio_browser_delete(sid, data: dict, codxjunior_session: CODXJuniorSession):
    """
    Delete a browser session via Socket.IO.
    Sends real-time status updates as the session stops.
    
    Request data:
        - session_id: str - Session ID to delete
    
    Emits events:
        - codx-junior-browser-status: {status, session_id, message, error}
    """
    channel = SessionChannel(sio=sio, sid=sid)
    session_id = data.get("session_id")
    
    if not session_id:
        logger.error("sio_browser_delete: session_id is required")
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "session_id is required",
            "error": "Missing session_id"
        })
        return
    
    try:
        from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
        
        browser_manager = BrowserManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        
        # Emit stopping event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "stopping",
            "session_id": session_id,
            "message": "Stopping browser session..."
        })
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("sio_browser_delete: session not found: %s", session_id)
            channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
                "status": "error",
                "session_id": session_id,
                "message": "Session not found",

            "session_id": session_id,
            "message": f"Browser session {session_id[:8]} deleted"
        })
        
        logger.info("sio_browser_delete: deleted session %s", session_id[:8])
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("sio_browser_delete: unexpected error: %s", e)
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "session_id": session_id,
            "message": "Failed to delete browser session",
            "error": str(e)
        })

## Summary

I've added comprehensive Socket.IO support for long-running browser operations:

### Changes Made:

**1. `codx/junior/sio/sio.py` - 4 New Event Handlers:**
- `codx-junior-browser-create` - Creates session with real-time status (starting → created → starting_container → ready)
- `codx-junior-browser-delete` - Stops and removes session (stopping → deleted)
- `codx-junior-browser-restart` - Restarts stopped session (restarting → ready)
- `codx-junior-browser-stop` - Stops container without deletion (stopping → stopped)

All handlers use `SessionChannel.send_event()` to emit `codx-junior-browser-status` events with real-time updates.

**2. `codx/junior/api/browser_models.py` - New Request/Response Models:**
- 4 Socket.IO request models (one per operation) with `codx_path` + operation-specific fields
- `BrowserStatusEvent` model for standardized status updates with status, session_id, message, error, and optional full session details

### Key Features:
✅ Real-time progress updates as operations progress
✅ Consistent error handling with error events
✅ Chat validation before creating browser sessions
✅ Follows existing `@sio_api_endpoint` decorator pattern
✅ Uses `SessionChannel` for proper WebSocket delivery
✅ All operations are async-safe
✅ Logging at each operation step

import os
import time
import asyncio
import logging

from threading import Thread
from typing import List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

CODX_JUNIOR_API_BACKGROUND = os.environ.get("CODX_JUNIOR_API_BACKGROUND")

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class IOEvent(BaseModel):
    sid: Optional[str] = Field(default=None) 
    event: str
    data: dict

EVENT_QUEUE: List[IOEvent] = []

def process_event_queue():
    from codx.junior.sio.sio import sio
    from codx.junior.sio.sio_background import sio_client
                    
    while True:
        if EVENT_QUEUE:
            try:
                event: IOEvent = EVENT_QUEUE.pop(0)
                    
                if CODX_JUNIOR_API_BACKGROUND:
                    resend_event = { "event": event.event, "data": event.data }
                    logger.info(f"Sending event bacground: {resend_event}")
                    sio_client.emit("background-event", resend_event)
                else:
                    asyncio.run(sio.emit(event.event, event.data))
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error processing event: {e}")
        else:
            time.sleep(0.2)
Thread(target=process_event_queue).start()

class SessionChannel:
    def __init__(self, sio, sid=None):
        self.sid = sid
        self.sio = sio

    def send_event(self, event, data):
        data["ts"] = int(time.time())
        EVENT_QUEUE.append(IOEvent(sid=self.sid, event=event, data=data))

async def execute_action(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
    req: BrowserSessionActionRequest,
):
    """
    Execute a browser action (navigate, click, fill, execute script).

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID
        req: BrowserSessionActionRequest with action details

    Returns:
        BrowserActionResponse with result or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("execute_action: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        if browser_session.status != "running":
            logger.error(
                "execute_action: session not running: %s (status=%s)",
                session_id,
                browser_session.status
            )
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})"
            )

        # Connect to browser
        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)

        try:
            if req.action == "navigate":
                if not req.url:
                    logger.error("execute_action: navigate action missing URL")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "URL required for navigate action")
                title = await browser.navigate(req.url)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: navigate action completed for session %s to %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.url
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Navigated to {req.url}",
                    data={"title": title, "url": req.url}
                )

            elif req.action == "click":
                if not req.selector:
                    logger.error("execute_action: click action missing selector")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for click action")
                await browser.click(req.selector)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: click action completed for session %s on %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.selector
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Clicked {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector}
                )

            elif req.action == "fill":
                if not req.selector or not req.value:
                    logger.error("execute_action: fill action missing selector or value")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and value required for fill action")
                await browser.fill(req.selector, req.value)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: fill action completed for session %s on %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.selector
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Filled {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector, "value": req.value}
                )

            elif req.action == "execute":
                if not req.script:
                    logger.error("execute_action: execute action missing script")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Script required for execute action")
                result = await browser.execute_script(req.script)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: execute action completed for session %s",
                    session_id[:8]
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message="Script executed",
                    data={"result": result}
                )

            else:
                logger.error("execute_action: unknown action: %s", req.action)
                raise HTTPException(400, f"Unknown action: {req.action}")

        finally:
            await browser.close()

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("execute_action: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

            return BrowserScreenshotResponse(
                success=False,
                error=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})"
            )

        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)
        try:
            screenshot = await browser.get_screenshot()
            browser_session.mark_active()
            browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
            logger.info("take_screenshot: screenshot completed for session %s", session_id[:8])
            return BrowserScreenshotResponse(success=True, screenshot=screenshot)
        finally:
            await browser.close()

    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("take_screenshot: unexpected error: %s", e)
        return BrowserScreenshotResponse(success=False, error=str(e))


@router.get(
    "/{session_id}/source",
    response_model=BrowserSourceResponse,
    summary="Get page source HTML",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Page source retrieved"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def get_source(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
):
    """
    Get the current page HTML source code.

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID

    Returns:
        BrowserSourceResponse with HTML content or error response
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("get_source: session not found: %s", session_id)
            return BrowserSourceResponse(
                success=False,
                error="Session not found"
            )

        if browser_session.status != "running":
            logger.error(
                "get_source: session not running: %s (status=%s)",
                session_id,
                browser_session.status
            )
            return BrowserSourceResponse(
                success=False,
                error=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})"
            )

        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)
        try:
            html = await browser.get_content()
            url = browser_session.current_url
            browser_session.mark_active()
            browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
            logger.info("get_source: source retrieved for session %s", session_id[:8])
            return BrowserSourceResponse(success=True, html=html, url=url)
        finally:
            await browser.close()

    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("get_source: unexpected error: %s", e)
        return BrowserSourceResponse(success=False, error=str(e))


# ============================================================================
# Socket.IO Events (Long-running operations with real-time updates)
# ============================================================================

def sio_browser_create(sid: str, data: dict, codxjunior_session: CODXJuniorSession):
    """
    Create a new browser session via Socket.IO.
    Sends real-time status updates as the session starts.
    
    Socket.IO Event: codx-junior-browser-create
    
    Request data:
        - chat_id: str - Associated chat ID
    
    Emits events:
        - codx-junior-browser-status: {status, session_id, message, error, session}
    """
    channel = SessionChannel(sio=None, sid=sid)
    chat_id = data.get("chat_id")
    
    if not chat_id:
        logger.error("sio_browser_create: chat_id is required")
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "chat_id is required",
            "error": "Missing chat_id"
        })
        return
    
    try:
        from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
        
        # Validate chat exists
        chat_manager = ChatManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("sio_browser_create: chat not found: %s", chat_id)
            channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
                "status": "error",
                "message": "Chat not found",
                "error": f"Chat {chat_id} not found"
            })
            return
        
        # Emit starting event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "starting",
            "message": "Creating browser session...",
            "chat_id": chat_id
        })
        
        # Create browser session
        browser_manager = BrowserManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(chat_id)
        
        # Emit creation event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "created",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": f"Browser session {browser_session.id[:8]} created",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict()
        })
        
        # Emit starting container event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "starting_container",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": "Starting Docker container...",
            "container_id": browser_session.container_id
        })
        
        # Sync to chat metadata
        browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
        chat_manager.save_chat(chat)
        
        # Emit ready event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "ready",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": f"Browser session ready",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict()
        })
        
        logger.info(
            "sio_browser_create: created session %s for chat %s",
            browser_session.id[:8],
            chat_id
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("sio_browser_create: unexpected error: %s", e)
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "Failed to create browser session",
            "error": str(e)
        })

"""
Browser Session REST API Router

Handles CRUD operations for browser sessions with full async support.

REST Endpoints:
    GET    /api/browsers              - List all sessions
    POST   /api/browsers              - Create new session
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id> - Get session details
    DELETE /api/browsers/<session_id> - Stop & delete session
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/action    - Execute browser action
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/screenshot - Take screenshot
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/source     - Get page source
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/restart    - Restart session

Socket.IO Events (Real-time operations with status updates):
    codx-junior-browser-create   - Create session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-delete   - Delete session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-restart  - Restart session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-stop     - Stop session with progress
    
    Emits: codx-junior-browser-status with {status, session_id, message, error, session}
"""

import logging
from typing import List, Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Depends, Request, status

from codx.junior.engine.session import CODXJuniorSession
from codx.junior.sio.session_channel import SessionChannel
from codx.junior.api.browser_models import (
    BrowserSessionResponse,
    BrowserSessionListResponse,
    BrowserSessionCreateRequest,
    BrowserSessionActionRequest,
    BrowserActionResponse,
    BrowserScreenshotResponse,
    BrowserSourceResponse,
)
from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/browsers", tags=["browser"])


# ============================================================================
# Dependencies
# ============================================================================

async def get_session_context(request: Request) -> CODXJuniorSession:
    """Dependency: get current session context from request state."""
    session = getattr(request.state, 'codx_junior_session', None)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="No active session"
        )
    return session


# ============================================================================
# REST Endpoints
# ============================================================================

@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionListResponse,
    summary="List all browser sessions",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "List of browser sessions"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def list_sessions(request: Request):
    """
    List all browser sessions for the current project.

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionListResponse with count and list of sessions
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        sessions = browser_manager.list_sessions()
        responses = [
            BrowserSessionResponse(**s.to_dict())
            for s in sessions
        ]
        logger.info("list_sessions: returned %d browser sessions", len(sessions))
        return BrowserSessionListResponse(count=len(responses), sessions=responses)
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("list_sessions: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Create a new browser session",
    responses={
        201: {"description": "Session created"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid request"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def create_session(
    request: Request,
    req: BrowserSessionCreateRequest,
):
    """
    Create and start a new browser session.

    Starts a Firefox Docker container with Traefik routing and persistent profile.

    Args:
        req: BrowserSessionCreateRequest with chat_id

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionResponse with session details or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        # Validate chat exists
        chat_manager = ChatManager(session.settings)
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(req.chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("create_session: chat not found: %s", req.chat_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Chat not found")

        # Create browser session
        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(req.chat_id)

        # Sync to chat metadata
        browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
        chat_manager.save_chat(chat)

        logger.info(
            "create_session: created browser session %s for chat %s",
            browser_session.id[:8],
            req.chat_id
        )

        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("create_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get(
    "/{session_id}",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    summary="Get session details",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Session details"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def get_session(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
):
    """
    Get details for a specific browser session.

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionResponse with session details or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("get_session: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        logger.info("get_session: retrieved session %s", session_id[:8])
        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("get_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.delete(
    "/{session_id}",
    status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT,
    summary="Stop and delete a session",
    responses={
        204: {"description": "Session deleted"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def delete_session(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
):
    """
    Stop Docker container and delete a browser session.

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID to delete

    Returns:
        Empty response on success, error dict on failure
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("delete_session: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        browser_manager.delete_session(session_id)
        logger.info("delete_session: deleted session %s", session_id[:8])

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("delete_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "/{session_id}/restart",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    summary="Restart a stopped session",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Session restarted"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def restart_session(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
):
    """
    Restart a stopped browser session (preserves Firefox profile).

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID to restart

    Returns:
        Updated BrowserSessionResponse or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = await browser_manager.restart_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("restart_session: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
        
        logger.info("restart_session: restarted session %s", session_id[:8])
        return BrowserSessionResponse(**browser_session.to_dict())

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("restart_session: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "/{session_id}/action",
    response_model=BrowserActionResponse,
    summary="Execute a browser action",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Action executed"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid action or session not running"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def execute_action(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
    req: BrowserSessionActionRequest,
):
    """
    Execute a browser action (navigate, click, fill, execute script).

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID
        req: BrowserSessionActionRequest with action details

    Returns:
        BrowserActionResponse with result or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("execute_action: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        if browser_session.status != "running":
            logger.error(
                "execute_action: session not running: %s (status=%s)",
                session_id,
                browser_session.status
            )
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})"
            )

        # Connect to browser
        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)

        try:

        # Emit starting event

@router.post(
    "/{session_id}/action",
    response_model=BrowserActionResponse,
    summary="Execute a browser action",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "Action executed"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid action or session not running"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def execute_action(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
    req: BrowserSessionActionRequest,
):
    """
    Execute a browser action (navigate, click, fill, execute script).

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID
        req: BrowserSessionActionRequest with action details

    Returns:
        BrowserActionResponse with result or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("execute_action: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        if browser_session.status != "running":
            logger.error(
                "execute_action: session not running: %s (status=%s)",
                session_id,
                browser_session.status
            )
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})"
            )

        # Connect to browser
        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)

        try:
            if req.action == "navigate":
                if not req.url:
                    logger.error("execute_action: navigate action missing URL")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "URL required for navigate action")
                title = await browser.navigate(req.url)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: navigate action completed for session %s to %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.url
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Navigated to {req.url}",
                    data={"title": title, "url": req.url}
                )

            elif req.action == "click":
                if not req.selector:
                    logger.error("execute_action: click action missing selector")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for click action")
                await browser.click(req.selector)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: click action completed for session %s on %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.selector
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Clicked {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector}
                )

            elif req.action == "fill":
                if not req.selector or not req.value:
                    logger.error("execute_action: fill action missing selector or value")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and value required for fill action")
                await browser.fill(req.selector, req.value)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: fill action completed for session %s on %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.selector
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Filled {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector, "value": req.value}
                )

            elif req.action == "execute":
                if not req.script:
                    logger.error("execute_action: execute action missing script")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Script required for execute action")
                result = await browser.execute_script(req.script)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: execute action completed for session %s",
                    session_id[:8]
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message="Script executed",
                    data={"result": result}
                )

            else:
                logger.error("execute_action: unknown action: %s", req.action)
                raise HTTPException(400, f"Unknown action: {req.action}")

        finally:
            await browser.close()

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("execute_action: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@sio.on("codx-junior-browser-create")
@sio_api_endpoint
async def sio_browser_create(sid: str, data: dict, codxjunior_session: CODXJuniorSession):
    """
    Create a new browser session via Socket.IO.
    Sends real-time status updates as the session starts.
    
    Socket.IO Event: codx-junior-browser-create
    
    Request data:
        - chat_id: str - Associated chat ID
    
    Emits events:
        - codx-junior-browser-status: {status, session_id, message, error, session}
    """
    channel = SessionChannel(sio=sio, sid=sid)
    chat_id = data.get("chat_id")
    
    if not chat_id:
        logger.error("sio_browser_create: chat_id is required")
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "chat_id is required",
            "error": "Missing chat_id"
        })
        return
    
    try:
        from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
        
        # Validate chat exists
        chat_manager = ChatManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        chat = chat_manager.find_by_id(chat_id)
        if not chat:
            logger.error("sio_browser_create: chat not found: %s", chat_id)
            channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
                "status": "error",
                "message": "Chat not found",
                "error": f"Chat {chat_id} not found"
            })
            return
        
        # Emit starting event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "starting",
            "message": "Creating browser session...",
            "chat_id": chat_id
        })
        
        # Create browser session
        browser_manager = BrowserManager(codxjunior_session.settings)
        browser_session = browser_manager.create_session(chat_id)
        
        # Emit creation event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "created",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": f"Browser session {browser_session.id[:8]} created",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict()
        })
        
        # Emit starting container event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "starting_container",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": "Starting Docker container...",
            "container_id": browser_session.container_id
        })
        
        # Sync to chat metadata
        browser_manager.save_session_to_chat(browser_session, chat)
        chat_manager.save_chat(chat)
        
        # Emit ready event
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "ready",
            "session_id": browser_session.id,
            "message": f"Browser session ready",
            "session": browser_session.to_dict()
        })
        
        logger.info(
            "sio_browser_create: created session %s for chat %s",
            browser_session.id[:8],
            chat_id
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("sio_browser_create: unexpected error: %s", e)
        channel.send_event("codx-junior-browser-status", {
            "status": "error",
            "message": "Failed to create browser session",
            "error": str(e)
        })

"""
Browser Session REST API Router

Handles CRUD operations for browser sessions with full async support.

REST Endpoints:
    GET    /api/browsers              - List all sessions
    POST   /api/browsers              - Create new session
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id> - Get session details
    DELETE /api/browsers/<session_id> - Stop & delete session
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/action    - Execute browser action
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/screenshot - Take screenshot
    GET    /api/browsers/<session_id>/source     - Get page source
    POST   /api/browsers/<session_id>/restart    - Restart session

Socket.IO Events (Real-time operations with status updates):
    codx-junior-browser-create   - Create session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-delete   - Delete session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-restart  - Restart session with progress
    codx-junior-browser-stop     - Stop session with progress
    
    Emits: codx-junior-browser-status with {status, session_id, message, error, session}
"""

import logging
from typing import List, Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Depends, Request, status

from codx.junior.engine.session import CODXJuniorSession
from codx.junior.sio.sio import sio, sio_api_endpoint
from codx.junior.sio.session_channel import SessionChannel
from codx.junior.api.browser_models import (
    BrowserSessionResponse,
    BrowserSessionListResponse,
    BrowserSessionCreateRequest,
    BrowserSessionActionRequest,
    BrowserActionResponse,
    BrowserScreenshotResponse,
    BrowserSourceResponse,
)
from codx.junior.chat_manager import ChatManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/browsers", tags=["browser"])


# ============================================================================
# Dependencies
# ============================================================================

async def get_session_context(request: Request) -> CODXJuniorSession:
    """Dependency: get current session context from request state."""
    session = getattr(request.state, 'codx_junior_session', None)
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="No active session"
        )
    return session


# ============================================================================
# REST Endpoints
# ============================================================================

@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionListResponse,
    summary="List all browser sessions",
    responses={
        200: {"description": "List of browser sessions"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def list_sessions(request: Request):
    """
    List all browser sessions for the current project.

    Returns:
        BrowserSessionListResponse with count and list of sessions
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        sessions = browser_manager.list_sessions()
        responses = [
            BrowserSessionResponse(**s.to_dict())
            for s in sessions
        ]
        logger.info("list_sessions: returned %d browser sessions", len(sessions))
        return BrowserSessionListResponse(count=len(responses), sessions=responses)
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("list_sessions: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=BrowserSessionResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Create a new browser session",
    responses={
        201: {"description": "Session created"},
        400: {"description": "Invalid request"},
        401: {"description": "Unauthorized"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def create_session(
    request: Request,
    req: BrowserSessionCreateRequest,

        404: {"description": "Session not found"},
        500: {"description": "Server error"},
    }
)
async def execute_action(
    request: Request,
    session_id: str,
    req: BrowserSessionActionRequest,
):
    """
    Execute a browser action (navigate, click, fill, execute script).

    Args:
        session_id: Session ID
        req: BrowserSessionActionRequest with action details

    Returns:
        BrowserActionResponse with result or error dict
    """
    try:
        session = await get_session_context(request)
        browser_manager = session.browser_manager if hasattr(session, 'browser_manager') else None
        if not browser_manager:
            from codx.junior.browser.browser_manager import BrowserManager
            browser_manager = BrowserManager(session.settings)
        
        browser_session = browser_manager.get_session(session_id)
        if not browser_session:
            logger.error("execute_action: session not found: %s", session_id)
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")

        if browser_session.status != "running":
            logger.error(
                "execute_action: session not running: %s (status=%s)",
                session_id,
                browser_session.status
            )
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Session not running (status: {browser_session.status})"
            )

        # Connect to browser
        browser = await browser_manager.connect_browser(browser_session)

        try:
            if req.action == "navigate":
                if not req.url:
                    logger.error("execute_action: navigate action missing URL")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "URL required for navigate action")
                title = await browser.navigate(req.url)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: navigate action completed for session %s to %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.url
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Navigated to {req.url}",
                    data={"title": title, "url": req.url}
                )

            elif req.action == "click":
                if not req.selector:
                    logger.error("execute_action: click action missing selector")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector required for click action")
                await browser.click(req.selector)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: click action completed for session %s on %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.selector
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Clicked {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector}
                )

            elif req.action == "fill":
                if not req.selector or not req.value:
                    logger.error("execute_action: fill action missing selector or value")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Selector and value required for fill action")
                await browser.fill(req.selector, req.value)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: fill action completed for session %s on %s",
                    session_id[:8],
                    req.selector
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message=f"Filled {req.selector}",
                    data={"selector": req.selector, "value": req.value}
                )

            elif req.action == "execute":
                if not req.script:
                    logger.error("execute_action: execute action missing script")
                    raise HTTPException(400, "Script required for execute action")
                result = await browser.execute_script(req.script)
                browser_session.mark_active()
                browser_manager.save_session(browser_session)
                logger.info(
                    "execute_action: execute action completed for session %s",
                    session_id[:8]
                )
                return BrowserActionResponse(
                    success=True,
                    message="Script executed",
                    data={"result": result}
                )

            else:
                logger.error("execute_action: unknown action: %s", req.action)
                raise HTTPException(400, f"Unknown action: {req.action}")

        finally:
            await browser.close()

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception("execute_action: unexpected error: %s", e)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

"""
DockerFirefoxManager — manages Firefox Docker container lifecycle.

Handles container creation, connection setup, and cleanup with Traefik routing.
Uses linuxserver/firefox image, connects to codx-junior_default network,
and configures Traefik labels for routing without explicit port mappings.

Lifecycle semantics
-------------------
- ``stop_container(session, remove=True)``  : stop + remove (full teardown).
- ``stop_container(session, remove=False)`` : stop only — the container is kept
  so it can be started again with ``restart_container`` (state preserved).
- ``restart_container(session)``            : starts an existing (stopped)
  container, or recreates it if the container no longer exists.
"""

import logging
import os
import subprocess
import time
from typing import Optional, List
from pathlib import Path

from codx.junior.browser.model import BrowserSession

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class DockerFirefoxManager:
    """
    Orchestrates Firefox Docker containers for browser automation.

    Each session gets a dedicated container with:
    - Traefik routing labels for VNC access (HTTP)
    - Chrome DevTools Protocol exposed on container port 9222
    - Connected to codx-junior_default network
    - Persistent profile volume for session state

    Docker image: lscr.io/linuxserver/firefox:latest
    Network: codx-junior_default (shared with codx-junior)
    """

    DOCKER_IMAGE = "lscr.io/linuxserver/firefox:latest"
    DOCKER_NETWORK = "codx-junior_default"
    MAX_SESSIONS = 10
    AUTH_MIDDLEWARE = "codx-junior-auth"

    def __init__(self, browser_sessions_path: str, traefik_domain: Optional[str] = None):
        """
        Initialize the Docker manager.

        Args:
            browser_sessions_path: Base path for browser session data (e.g., .codx/browser_sessions/)
            traefik_domain: Traefik domain for routing (e.g., app.example.com)
        """
        self.browser_sessions_path = browser_sessions_path
        self.traefik_domain = traefik_domain or os.environ.get("CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN", "localhost")
        os.makedirs(browser_sessions_path, exist_ok=True)
        logger.debug(
            "DockerFirefoxManager initialized at '%s' (domain: %s)",
            browser_sessions_path,
            self.traefik_domain,
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Container lifecycle
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def start_container(self, session: BrowserSession) -> BrowserSession:
        """
        Start a new Firefox Docker container for the session.

        Creates profile directory, starts container with Traefik labels,
        waits for readiness, then updates session with connection details.

        Args:
            session: BrowserSession with id set

        Returns:
            Updated BrowserSession with container_id and URLs

        Raises:
            RuntimeError: If container startup fails
        """
        session_folder = self._get_session_folder(session.id)
        profile_path = os.path.join(session_folder, "firefox_profile")
        os.makedirs(profile_path, exist_ok=True)

        container_name = f"browser_{session.id[:8]}"
        traefik_path_prefix = f"/browser/{session.id}"

        try:
            # Build traefik labels
            router_name = f"codx-junior-browser-{session.id[:8]}"
            traefik_labels = self._build_traefik_labels(
                router_name=router_name,
                session_id=session.id,
                path_prefix=traefik_path_prefix,
            )

            # Build docker run command
            cmd = [
                "docker",
                "run",
                "-d",  # detached mode
                "--name", container_name,
                "--network", self.DOCKER_NETWORK,
                "-e", "PUID=1000",
                "-e", "PGID=1000",
                "-e", "TZ=Etc/UTC",
                "-v", f"{profile_path}:/home/abc/.mozilla",  # Firefox profile
                "--shm-size=2gb",  # Prevent browser rendering crashes
            ]

            # Add traefik labels
            for label in traefik_labels:
                cmd.extend(["-l", label])

            cmd.append(self.DOCKER_IMAGE)

            logger.info(
                "Starting Firefox container: %s (network: %s, path: %s)",
                container_name,
                self.DOCKER_NETWORK,
                traefik_path_prefix,
            )
            result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

            if result.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Docker run failed: {result.stderr}")

            container_id = result.stdout.strip()
            logger.info("Container started: %s (ID: %s)", container_name, container_id[:12])

            # Wait for container to be ready
            self._wait_for_container_ready(container_id, timeout=15)

            # Update session with connection details
            session.container_id = container_id
            session.container_name = container_name
            session.browser_profile_path = profile_path
            session.traefik_domain = self.traefik_domain
            session.traefik_path_prefix = traefik_path_prefix
            session.vnc_url = f"http://{self.traefik_domain}{traefik_path_prefix}"
            session.debug_url = "ws://localhost:9222"  # Local development; adjust for production
            session.status = "running"
            session.error = None
            session.mark_active()

            return session

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("Failed to start Firefox container")
            session.status = "error"
            session.error = str(e)
            raise

    def stop_container(self, session: BrowserSession, remove: bool = True) -> None:
        """
        Stop a Firefox container, optionally removing it.

        Args:
            session: BrowserSession with container_id set
            remove: When True (default) the container is stopped **and removed**
                (full teardown). When False the container is only stopped so it
                can be started again with :meth:`restart_container`.
        """
        if not session or not session.container_id:
            logger.warning(
                "Cannot stop session %s: no container_id",
                session.id[:8] if session else "?",
            )
            return

        try:
            logger.info(
                "Stopping container: %s (remove=%s)", session.container_id[:12], remove
            )
            subprocess.run(
                ["docker", "stop", session.container_id],
                capture_output=True,
                timeout=15,
            )
            if remove:
                subprocess.run(
                    ["docker", "rm", session.container_id],
                    capture_output=True,
                    timeout=10,
                )
                session.container_id = None
            session.status = "stopped"
            logger.info("Container stopped: %s", session.container_id)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("Error stopping container: %s", e)
            session.status = "error"
            session.error = f"Stop failed: {e}"

    def restart_container(self, session: BrowserSession) -> BrowserSession:
        """
        Restart a stopped session, recreating the container if needed.

        If the container still exists (previously stopped with
        ``stop_container(remove=False)``) it is simply started again, preserving
        the profile. If the container was removed, a fresh container is created
        from the same session folder (profile is preserved on disk).

        Args:
            session: BrowserSession to restart

        Returns:
            Updated BrowserSession

        Raises:
            RuntimeError: If restart fails
        """
        if session.container_id and self._container_exists(session.container_id):
            try:
                logger.info("Restarting container: %s", session.container_id[:12])
                subprocess.run(
                    ["docker", "start", session.container_id],
                    capture_output=True,
                    timeout=15,
                )
                self._wait_for_container_ready(session.container_id, timeout=15)
                session.status = "running"
                session.error = None
                session.mark_active()
                return session
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception("Failed to restart existing container")
                session.status = "error"
                session.error = str(e)
                raise

        # Container gone → recreate it (profile on disk is preserved)
        logger.info("Container missing for session %s; recreating", session.id[:8])
        session.container_id = None
        return self.start_container(session)

    def remove_container(self, session: BrowserSession) -> None:
        """Stop and remove the container (alias of stop_container(remove=True))."""
        self.stop_container(session, remove=True)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Utilities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _container_exists(self, container_id: str) -> bool:
        """Return True when the given container (id or name) still exists."""
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Id}}", container_id],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5,
            )
            return result.returncode == 0 and bool(result.stdout.strip())
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _get_session_folder(self, session_id: str) -> str:
        """Get the folder path for a session."""
        return os.path.join(self.browser_sessions_path, session_id)

    def _get_session_file_path(self, session_id: str) -> str:
        """Get the metadata file path for a session."""
        return os.path.join(self._get_session_folder(session_id), f"{session_id}.session")

    def _build_traefik_labels(
        self,
        router_name: str,
        session_id: str,
        path_prefix: str,
    ) -> List[str]:
        """
        Build Traefik Docker labels for routing.

        Args:
            router_name: Unique router name for this container
            session_id: Session ID
            path_prefix: URL path prefix (e.g., /browser/<session_id>)

        Returns:
            List of label strings for docker run -l flag
        """
        labels = [
            "traefik.enable=true",
            f"traefik.http.routers.{router_name}.rule=Host(`{self.traefik_domain}`) && PathPrefix(`{path_prefix}`)",
            f"traefik.http.routers.{router_name}.service={router_name}-service",
            f"traefik.http.services.{router_name}-service.loadbalancer.server.port=3000",
            f"traefik.http.services.{router_name}-service.loadbalancer.server.scheme=http",
            f"traefik.http.middlewares.{router_name}-path.replacepathregex.regex=^{path_prefix}/(.*)",
            f"traefik.http.middlewares.{router_name}-path.replacepathregex.replacement=/$1",
            f"traefik.http.routers.{router_name}.middlewares={router_name}-path,{self.AUTH_MIDDLEWARE}",
        ]
        return labels

    def _wait_for_container_ready(self, container_id: str, timeout: int = 15) -> None:
        """
        Wait for container to be ready (health check).

        Args:
            container_id: Docker container ID
            timeout: Maximum wait time in seconds

        Raises:
            TimeoutError: If container doesn't become ready in time
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
            try:
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ["docker", "exec", container_id, "test", "-S", "/tmp/.X11-unix/X0"],
                    capture_output=True,
                    timeout=5,
                )
                if result.returncode == 0:
                    logger.debug("Container %s is ready", container_id[:12])
                    return
            except Exception:
                pass
            time.sleep(1)

        raise TimeoutError(f"Container {container_id[:12]} failed to become ready in {timeout}s")

    def cleanup_all_containers(self) -> None:
        """
        Stop all Firefox browser containers (cleanup on shutdown).
        """
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["docker", "ps", "-a", "-q", "--filter", "name=browser_"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=10,
            )
            if result.returncode == 0:
                container_ids = result.stdout.strip().split("\n")
                for cid in filter(None, container_ids):
                    try:
                        subprocess.run(
                            ["docker", "stop", cid],
                            capture_output=True,
                            timeout=5,
                        )
                        subprocess.run(
                            ["docker", "rm", cid],
                            capture_output=True,
                            timeout=5,
                        )
                        logger.info("Cleaned up container: %s", cid[:12])
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.warning("Failed to cleanup container %s: %s", cid[:12], e)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Error during cleanup_all_containers: %s", e)
